title: Opt-in private AE TDB stream factory getter read-only probe
question: Can an independently built AEGP resolve and execute only Get_AE_StreamFactory() from a pinned TDB.dll without dereferencing or mutating its returned pointer?
procedure: Only run on an isolated disposable AE project/session after explicit opt-in; close/restart AE to deploy AEX
Invoke Animation > ShapeLayerAE: Probe Private TDB Getter (Read Only)
Check code gates TDB.dll loaded, decorated export exists, 48 8B 05 disp32 C3 opcode fingerprint
If fingerprint matches, call no-argument getter; record only non-null Boolean, never dereference pointer
Record raw TSV, host version and module hash, crashes and rollback if any
conclusion: C++ compiled. NO in-host private API invocation has been performed.
limitations: Executing even a simple private getter is unsupported and version-sensitive
Getter pointer availability does not establish permissible registration or native vector output

hypotheses.prediction: A pinned private TDB getter can return a non-null global factory pointer from an explicit AEGP command
hypotheses.falsified_by: Module/export/fingerprint unavailable or getter result null in controlled host

build_receipt.installed_version: older v2; current user AE process not touched
